You will design, document, and implement functional and non-functional requirements using approved methodology, and apply best practices and knowledge of internal or external business needs to achieve strategic objectives. People who do well in this role are often quick to grasp how telephony systems and integrations fit together.
cond_0058.responsibilities:
Participate in the design, implementation, and long-term management of telephony related products and services.
Collaborate with other cross functional teams to scope and launch new products, services, and features.
Troubleshoot and debug VOIP integration and feature development issues.
Optimize system performance and quality.
Work with third party vendors to deliver and integrate solutions for the benefit of our customer base.
Develop, maintain, and execute on disaster recovery / redundancy strategies.
Ability to solve complex technical issues.
Establish and maintain best practices as it relates to compliance, security, privacy, and legal requirements.
Anticipate deviations from standard practices and find practical ways to move forward.
Break down complex problems into smaller, more manageable ones, and help others to do the same.
Understand what tools are available and useful for the domain, how they work, and the sorts of situations and problems for which they're useful.
cond_0058.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree in Telecom, Electrical Engineering and or Computer Science or related technical field or equivalent practical experience.
Minimum of 8 years of VOIP / Telecom relevant experience with development, integration, and deployment of complete solutions.
Experience with real-time communication that include voice, telephony (SBC's), SIP (Session Initiation Protocol), QoS, DHCP and DNS.
Experience with multiple delivery methodologies such as Agile and Waterfall.
Solid understanding of traditional or cloud computing technologies including Networking, Compute, Storage, Development, Data, Operations, or Security.
Preferred Requirements
Experience with Zoom Phone deployments.
Hands on Knowledge of Java/Python/Go concurrency / multithreading and asynchronous.

cond_0314.intro: We are looking for a Unified Communications Engineer with a strong networking and telecommunications background to join our team. This role covers the analysis, design, development, implementation, and maintenance of infrastructure, software, and telephony solutions. You will own the design and delivery of functional and non-functional requirements using approved methodology, and apply best practices and knowledge of business needs to achieve strategic objectives.
cond_0314.responsibilities:
Lead the design, implementation, and long-term management of telephony products and services.
Drive collaboration with cross-functional teams to scope and launch new products, services, and features.
Diagnose and resolve VOIP integration and feature development issues.
Own system performance optimization and quality.
Direct coordination with third-party vendors to deliver and integrate solutions for the customer base.
Develop, maintain, and execute disaster recovery and redundancy strategies.
Resolve complex technical issues independently.
Establish and maintain best practices for compliance, security, privacy, and legal requirements.
Anticipate deviations from standard practices and determine practical ways to move forward.
Break down complex problems into smaller, manageable ones, and guide others to do the same.
Identify and apply the right tools for the domain, understanding how they work and when to use them.
cond_0314.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree in Telecom, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
At least 8 years of VOIP/Telecom experience covering development, integration, and deployment of complete solutions.
Experience with real-time communication including voice, telephony (SBCs), SIP, QoS, DHCP, and DNS.
Experience with multiple delivery methodologies such as Agile and Waterfall.
Solid understanding of traditional or cloud computing technologies including Networking, Compute, Storage, Development, Data, Operations, or Security.
Preferred Requirements
Experience with Zoom Phone deployments.
Hands-on knowledge of Java, Python, or Go concurrency, multithreading, and asynchronous programming.
Experience with CI/CD concepts and tools, branching strategies, and infrastructure-as-a-product delivery.

cond_0441.intro: We are looking for a Unified Communications Engineer with a strong networking and telecommunications background to join our team. This role works across teams to support the analysis, design, development, implementation, and maintenance of infrastructure, software, and telephony solutions. You will help ensure functional and non-functional requirements are documented and implemented using approved methodology, and work alongside colleagues to support internal and external business needs.
cond_0441.responsibilities:
Coordinate with cross-functional teams on the design, implementation, and long-term management of telephony products and services.
Collaborate with other teams to scope and launch new products, services, and features.
Work with colleagues to troubleshoot and debug VOIP integration and feature development issues.
Support efforts to optimize system performance and quality.
Partner with third-party vendors to deliver and integrate solutions for our customer base.
Share responsibility for developing, maintaining, and executing disaster recovery and redundancy strategies.
Help resolve complex technical issues alongside team members.
Work with others to establish and maintain best practices related to compliance, security, privacy, and legal requirements.
Anticipate deviations from standard practices and coordinate with the team to find practical ways to move forward.
Help break down complex problems into smaller, manageable ones, and support others in doing the same.
Share knowledge of available tools for the domain, how they work, and the situations for which they are useful.
cond_0441.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree in Telecom, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
Minimum of 8 years of VOIP/Telecom experience covering development, integration, and deployment of complete solutions.
Experience with real-time communication including voice, telephony (SBCs), SIP, QoS, DHCP, and DNS.
Experience with multiple delivery methodologies such as Agile and Waterfall.
Solid understanding of traditional or cloud computing technologies including Networking, Compute, Storage, Development, Data, Operations, or Security.
Preferred Requirements
Experience with Zoom Phone deployments.
Hands-on knowledge of Java/Python/Go concurrency, multithreading, and asynchronous programming.
Experience with CI/CD concepts and tools, branching strategies, and delivering infrastructure as a product.

The engineer will design, document, and implement functional and non-functional requirements using approved methodology, applying best practices and knowledge of business needs to meet technical objectives.
cond_0511.responsibilities:
Participate in the design, implementation, and long-term management of telephony related products and services.
Coordinate with cross-functional teams to scope and launch new products, services, and features.
Troubleshoot and debug VOIP integration and feature development issues.
Optimize system performance and quality.
Work with third-party vendors to deliver and integrate solutions for the customer base.
Develop, maintain, and execute disaster recovery and redundancy strategies.
Resolve complex technical issues.
Establish and maintain best practices related to compliance, security, privacy, and legal requirements.
Identify deviations from standard practices and find practical ways to move forward.
Break down complex problems into smaller, manageable components.
Understand available tools for the domain, how they work, and the situations for which they are suited.
cond_0511.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree in Telecom, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
Minimum of 8 years of VOIP/Telecom experience covering development, integration, and deployment of complete solutions.
Experience with real-time communication including voice, telephony (SBCs), SIP, QoS, DHCP, and DNS.
Experience with multiple delivery methodologies such as Agile and Waterfall.
Solid understanding of traditional or cloud computing technologies including Networking, Compute, Storage, Development, Data, Operations, or Security.
Preferred Requirements
Experience with Zoom Phone deployments.
Hands-on knowledge of Java, Python, or Go concurrency, multithreading, and asynchronous programming.
Experience with CI/CD concepts and tools, branching strategies, and delivering infrastructure as a product.
cond_0511.encouragement_text: Important: Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply.
